scope: Fixture-based integration summary. All results from deterministic rule-based baselines. Not a trained-LLM or production-security result.
disclaimer: These results validate the Defender enforcement environment and interface contracts. SFT warm-up and MAPPO training are BLOCKED_EXTERNAL pending team base-model decision. Metrics will be updated once training runs.

interfaces_implemented.DefenderObservation: Frozen; task_id, user_task, untrusted_content, safe_context, allowed_action_schema. No critic/attacker hidden state.
interfaces_implemented.RawModelOutput: Pre-gate model proposal; text, optional tool_name/args/purpose, log_prob, entropy.
interfaces_implemented.BaseModelAdapter: Abstract act() contract; validated schema version; FixtureModelAdapter and SFTModelAdapter stubs.
interfaces_implemented.DefenderAction: Frozen; validated gate result, pre_gate_unsafe flag, log_prob, action_mask_version.
interfaces_implemented.TrajectoryStep: observation + action + reward_components; advantage/value_estimate reserved for Member 3.

loss_components.kl_penalty: Token-level KL(pi_theta || pi_SFT); beta_kl=0.1; zero when current==reference

episode_harness.gate_invariant: PolicyGate runs on every non-fixture tool proposal; never bypassed
